verdict.rationale: OpenHands is operated primarily through natural-language tasks. Its default interactive CLI lets users type natural-language tasks and get instant feedback, and it also takes natural-language instructions for browser actions and through @openhands mentions in Slack. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration beyond first-party docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Type natural language tasks and receive instant feedback
navigating websites, clicking elements, filling forms, and extracting content - all through natural language instructions
Watch Slack channels for @openhands mentions, open a conversation with the message context, and reply when the agent finishes.
